[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
=== Original census review — 31 October 2026 ===
The original 1841 Holly Walk census image has now been inspected through Findmypast: HO107/1135/14, folio 11, printed page 15, Leamington Priors. Robert is 65; Mary is entered with the Glasgow surname repeated by ditto and a Scotland birthplace mark. Mary’s final age digit remains ambiguous between 17 and 19: Findmypast transcribes 17, FreeCEN 19. Ann’s age also has an unresolved final digit (40/44; both providers transcribe 40). The schedule has no relationship column. These are readings of one census, not three independent family witnesses.

The original does not prove Mary was Robert’s daughter or identify her with Mary Wilhelmina Campbell. Its 17/19 age reading still conflicts with the comparison bride’s 1816 birth and copied 1851 age 34. Keep that daughter-in-law comparison unselected and the existing father at 45%; Jane’s father remains 78%. No parent, identity, mother or vital-field change is made. The existing 1804 France birth fields remain unverified and conflict with the census, rather than being confirmed by it. A full original 1851 household and the 1839 marriage remain the discriminating identity tests.<ref>1841 census, HO107/1135/14, folio 11, page 15, Holly Walk, Leamington Priors; [https://search.findmypast.co.uk/record?id=GBC%2F1841%2F1135%2F0425&parentid=GBC%2F1841%2F0005104748 Findmypast original image] inspected 31 October 2026. Findmypast Mary 17 and FreeCEN Mary 19 remain unresolved readings of the same entry.</ref>

=== Updated census source and open identity comparison — 31 October 2026 ===
The Holly Walk household now has a precise census locator: HO107/1135, enumeration district 10, folio 11, page 15, Leamington Priors (FreeCEN district Kenilworth). FreeCEN transcribes Mary Glasgow 19 and Wilhelmina Robertson 1, both born Scotland, with Robert Glasgow 65. It gives no relationship labels. This may be the source of the old copied WikiTree paragraph, so it is one census record, not independent family testimony.

A specific daughter-in-law alternative can now be tested. Paterson’s 1866 county history, printed pp. 513–514 (PDF 249–250), says the elder Robert’s eldest son and heir, born 22 May 1811, married Mary-Wilhelmina, daughter of John Campbell of Stonefield, on 11 July 1839; their children include Wilhelmina-Colquhoun. The checked existing bride is Campbell-38211 and groom Robertson-Glasgow-11. A married Mary beside the infant of this same family could be that daughter-in-law rather than another daughter of the household head. This is a new comparison, not an established identification.

The age problem remains real: FreeCEN gives Mary 19 in 1841, while Campbell-38211’s public profile gives 1816 and copies an 1851 age 34. The latter original is also unread. The infant’s full name and birth particulars are not established by FreeCEN. Paterson is a compiled family history, not an original marriage entry, and its adjacent Montgreenan descent narrative has known conflicts with the separately held court evidence. Do not transfer the book’s explicit John Campbell parentage to Glasgow-3021 before identifying the two Marys. Retain the selected Robert Robertson father at 45%, Jane’s father at 78%, all mother/vital fields and separate profiles; no father replacement, merge or confidence improvement is recorded.<ref>[https://www.freecen.org.uk/search_records/5905ca04e9379091b1863863/robert-glasgow-1841-warwickshire-kenilworth-1776- FreeCEN 1841, HO107/1135, ED 10, folio 11, page 15]; [https://www.kilwinningheritage.org.uk/office/resources/documents/history-of-the-counties-of-ayr-and-wigton-vol-3-pt-2-paterson-1863.pdf Paterson 1866, vol. III part II, pp. 513–514]. Transcript and printed pages inspected31 October 2026; original census/marriage unread. Compare [[Campbell-38211]] and [[Robertson-Glasgow-11]] without merging or substituting a father.</ref>

Jane was born in 1804. She is the daughter of [[Robertson-30564|Robert Robertson]] and [[Glasgow-2874|Anne Glasgow]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Father assessment — 24 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Robertson-30564|Robert Robertson, later Glasgow]] is assessed 78% probable. Robert’s captured compiled account names a daughter Philadelphia Jane; the copied 1841 household places Jane Robertson, aged 20, with Robert and the same family. The compatible name and specific family setting support identification of this profile with that daughter, while leaving the full identity provisional. The compiled family account and copied household are not independent original proof. The original census and a full-name record have not been inspected. The inherited 1804 France birth fields conflict with age 20 if literal; neither is verified. This is the first numerical rating of a retained unmarked father, not a new attachment or discovery.

The earlier narrative and copied household text below are preserved as historical profile material; their unverified birth dates and relationships do not supersede this assessment. No new mother or vital-field conclusion follows from this father review.

Next test: Locate the original census and a record identifying Philadelphia Jane by full name, later surname or explicit father.

The household text is a quotation in the existing profile, not an inspected census schedule.<ref>[https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3022 Captured public WikiTree biography of Glasgow-3022, household source paragraph, reviewed 24 October 2026]; underlying census uninspected.</ref>

The surname change and compiled child list are cited in Robert’s captured account; the will, marriage and other archival citations in that account were not independently inspected in this review.<ref>[https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Robertson-30564 Captured public WikiTree biography of Robert Robertson, later Glasgow], citing T71/892, T71/1266 and SC6/44/4/1, reviewed 24 October 2026. This is a compiled account.</ref>


== Sources ==
<references />
* In 1841, Robert Glasgow, age 65, of independent means, born in Scotland, was living at Holly Walk, Leamington Priors, with Ann Glasgow age 40, Mary Glasgow age 19, Ann Robertson age 18, Jane Robertson age 20, Charlotte Robertson age 10 and Wilhelmina Robertson age 1, one male servant and four female servants. All the children were listed as being born in Scotland. Wilhelmina was the daughter of Robert Glasgow's eldest son, also Robert. The baptism of Charlotte in Edinburgh on 20/07/1828 gives her birth as Rome, 22/11/1827. Anne Glasgow the elder has not been traced and had presumably died by 1841. Anne Glasgow or Robertson the younger was born in Edinburgh 05/10/1805 and baptised 26/03/1805 in Ayton, Berwickshire. It is this younger Anne, the daughter, not the wife of Robert, who appears in the 1841 census.
